articles.summary: Partnership gives Republic Bank parents powerful tools to teach money management skills to their children. Republic Bank (“Republic” or the “Bank”) has announced a new partnership with Greenlight, the award-winning money and safety app for families, giving Republic Bank checking account holders access to the Greenlight SELECT plan at no cost. Trusted by more than six million parents and kids nationwide, Greenlight helps families teach financial responsibility through real-world money management experiences. The Greenlight SELECT plan allows parents to assign chores, automate allowance payments, send money for everyday expenses, and monitor spending through customizable controls and real-time alerts. Along with a prepaid debit card designed for kids and teens, Greenlight helps young users build healthy financial habits through savings goals and its Level Up financial literacy program, which features educational games and challenges.
